scope: Fully coupled optimization is required for submission. The prescribed-flow evidence and all frozen numerical procedures remain unchanged.

forward_correction.control_scope: The first forward checks use the original saved control only to verify the corrected procedure. Physical-resolution evidence for publication must use the final optimized control.

physics.source_policy: Keep signed sources unchanged on each fixed-control replay; preserve their original piecewise-constant time representation.

resolution.policy: Refine space and physical time separately. Evaluate every stored time level. No optimality or physical-resolution claim follows from a solver iteration test.

optimization.selection: Complete the declared pilot population first. Choose the lowest complete median time among accuracy- and memory-qualified configurations; break exact ties by lower memory, then lower rank. Retain every outcome. Freeze the selected configuration before final comparisons.
optimization.targets: Target 7 plus two nonduplicate targets chosen before final outcomes: closest desired-field amplitude to the population median, then maximum remaining amplitude; ties use the lowest target index. Evaluate amplitudes with the same physical weights and mesh for every target.
optimization.cost: Charge construction, all outer and inner solves, transfers, verification and cleanup. Keep preparation-inclusive totals identifiable. Never derive a completed-solve speedup from a capped or failed baseline.

publication.positive_claim: A complete time-to-accuracy saving against a named successful matched comparator, with ranges and memory. Kernel or local correction savings are separate findings.
publication.release: Remain local until pushing is authorized. The approved institutional identifier is supplied by the author.
